notes.title: New UPDATE FIX BUGS , DELETES YOUR SAVE FILES
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Folks ,[/b] 

I just released a new update and sadly this will delete your [b][i]savegames files[/i][/b] since the updated changes a few things :  

[list]
[*]This should fix the [b]GAME CRASH[/b] and uses less [b]Ram[/b] now you should easily play in full screen without crashes :)
[*]There are less checkpoints now  
[*]There'll be a save game folder now on your [b][i]steam game directory[/i][/b] this way the next update will not delete your [b][i]savegames files[/i][/b]
[*][spoiler]Fix the old mine boxes bugs[/spoiler]
[*]Fix sound Fx effects
[*]New sounds are going to make your experience better 
[*]A thumb was added to the soundtrack dlc
[/list]


After testing new bugs came out but now they're fixed :) ! Thank you all who helped me reporting 'em

Let me know guys id there's still persistence of any bug
Endrit :)
